notes.title: 1.2 Version Preview
notes.notes:
1.2 Version Preview

It's been a while!
We would like to reveal the long-awaited information about version 1.2.
This patch is scheduled to be updated sometime in February.



1. Miko class
- Finally, a new class Miko has come. Miko class has poor stats and has powerful skill effects.

2. New common skills and artifacts
- With the addition of class, new common skills and artifacts are added to assist it.

3. Balance patch
- Balance patch for common skills and artifacts.
- Change the stats obtained after defeating mid-boss.
- A nerf will be made regarding mage-type monsters that ignore defense.

4. Modify map setting
- Plan to adjust the object placement on some stages.

5. Story rework for the 3rd tower
- Story rework is currently progressing slowly. When version 1.2 is released, it will be set to 3rd tower.
- 2nd tower stories will be added as soon as they are completed. However, along with class upgrades, the amount is greater than other parts, so it's taking more time than expected.

6. Modify Collector function
- It is too difficult to use Collector function, so we would like to change the contents. Maybe artifacts of fixed items to be purchasable.

7. Encyclopedia Upgrade
- Plan to add more terms into the guide.

8. Tutorial rework
- Tutorial part is not yet perfect in helping you understand the game. A slight rework is planned.
- In addition, buff the starting stats of all classes.

9. Add effects
- Planning to add some effects.


1.2 version will add a lot of content. Because of this, we have not been able to post any other news or patches until now. Thank you for your patience. 
Regardless of this patch, we plan to carry out a balance patch for the Ranger and Demon Hunter classes sometime next week.

notes.title: 1.1 version patch completed
notes.notes:
You've been waiting a long time!
Later than expected, but patch 1.1 is complete!
It took more time because we found unexpected things. We would like to apologize to those who have been waiting.


[Patch Note]

1. Remake Story
: Chapter 1 has been remade. In particular, the quality of English version was not good because it's Google Translator, but with the remade story is translated properly.
: The original plan was to have up to Chapter 2, but translation could not be completed. This patch will take place between class patches.

2. Add True Ending
: When you clear the 5th tower with never die, you can enter the true ending route. Please remember to try with a new save file.
: During development, there was a concept of forcing the player to return to the beginning if they were defeated in true ending route, but this was deleted because it was truly nonsense. If you lose during a challenge, you can return to the first scene of true ending route and try again.

3. Balance Patch
: Other minor map and object point change patches that were announced have not yet been applied. Currently, opinions on the level of difficulty are so different that they are polarized that we plan to conduct more QA testing before applying it. This will be applied gradually with class patches.

4. System Rework
: The save, script, and other systems have been reworked.

It's very unfortunate that we can only show half of what we prepared due to various reasons. However, we are developing the game every day, and we will work hard until it is completed, so we would thank it if you could trust and wait.

Class : Sniper patch has been completed.
Currently, work on version 1.1 is in the final stages, so please wait a little longer.

notes.title: Balance Patch : Sniper
notes.notes:
The sniper is a class that finishes battles as quickly as possible with powerful damage and minimizes losses. However, the number of monsters that snipers can kill without taking damage is very small, but many monsters that can counter them, so the sniper's skill tree has been buffed to solve this problem. Additionally, some skill names and scripts have been modified to be more appropriate.


*Long range passive skill details changed
- 1st level : First Strike, Remove low speed penalty
- 2nd level : AP +1 on 1st turn
- 3rd level : Enemy SPD decrease to 1/2

*Double Shot → Explosive Arrow
- Effect changes according to tier adjustment

*Take Cover
- Changed to a skill that gains XP at startup.

*Explosive Arrow → Scatter Arrow
- 6 hits skill

*Pierce Arrow → Reserved Arrow
- Increased number of class skill uses instead of pierce bonus

In addition, minor effect modifications were made.
Not only snipers, but all currently released classes will be adjusted once in a while.
This patch is scheduled to be patched within this week.

notes.title: Official version 1.1 patch Roadmap
notes.notes:

: Balance patches are applied to some artifacts.

notes.title: News about changes since the early version
notes.notes:
Anyone who has played the early access version or demo will notice that game has changed a lot. In addition to simply adding chapters, many things have changed. We will briefly inform you of what changes have occurred.


1. Convenience features

- Pressing Shift during battle will make the battle speed faster.
- Speed ​​control system has been added. It consists of 3 levels, and you can select you want to make the battle speed more faster. It can be set in options.
- Quick preset change system has been added. You can change a preset by pressing the left number key. Additionally, you can check the currently set preset number at the bottom left.
- You can find detailed information about the game through the encyclopedia.


2. New features

- You can find a Paddler in the commercial district. It sells rare items such as CP and PP stones. Items will remain even if you do not purchase them.
- You can find a Blacksmith in the military district. You can upgrade your weapons using godstone and mystic powder. Weapons have special effects when full upgrade.
- You can find a Collector in the military district. Collecting all of specific artifacts will grant you a comp artifact from Collector.
- You can find a Maid in the resident district. A special item is provided upon each return, and if you visit with a specific artifact, it will be randomly replaced with next tier artifact.
- You can find a Gambler in the resident district. Investing gold with a Gambler gives you a chance to win a prize on your next visit.
- Skill reset object has been added. You can find them during expedition, and you can only reset your presets once per visit. Please note that once you start setting, the number of times will be used up.
- When the game over, you can return to previous save point and get candle stacks. You can find a Old man in the military district and purchase stats using candle.
- KO stat has been added. If KO value exceeds 100 during battle, KO skill is activated. It kills common enemies immediately and causes great damage to elite and boss monstes. KO stat are retained after battle, allowing to use strategically.
- Items for sale in some town stores have been modified.


3. Improved features

- The acquisition period for class skills has been changed. Depending on progress of main story, certain skills are automatically unlocked.
- PP cost of class skills has been unified by tier. Balance work was carried out accordingly.
- Improvements have been made to several graphics sources.

notes.title: 11/4 1.0 ver Official release notice
notes.notes:
Waited a long time, everyone. The work has finally been completed to the point where TOD can be officially presented. There is still some work left to do, but there is no problem in playng game to the end.

Brief news will be posted every day for the remaining period until launch. It will focus on changes compared to early version, newly added content, and planned content that has not been released yet. The price will also be discounted on the day of release.

After the official version release, there will be several updates in addition to maintenance. The miko class will be locked for the time being due to content and balance issues, reworked story has not been applied, and true ending is also in maintenance step. The encyclopedia is also being modified to look better. We plan to apply these major patches in three phases.

Thank you for waiting for a long time.

notes.title: Official release notice!
notes.notes:
Long time no see, everyone!
TOD is almost ready for 1.0 ver official release.
It has been through a long development period so far.
With a lot of trial and error and dozens of beta test updates, we finally reached the complete of the game.
We would like to thank everyone who purchased, supported, and waited during the early access phase.

In the later stages of development, many existing rules and level designs had to be changed. Therefore, it was difficult to apply it in regular updates, so update was carried out only as a beta test. However, although it was a measure to make the game more good, it is true that regular updates were neglected, so we apologize if there are people who are disappointed due to the slow update.

Release schedule is expected to be in September. We are currently focusing on bug checking, progress review, and work on new classes to be introduced. In addition to completing the game, upgrades other than the beta are required outside of the game, such as a new introduction and teaser video. Please wait a little longer.

We will launch the regular version update within this week at the latest. This version will probably not be much different from 1.0 ver official version. Alpha testing was conducted properly, but as some users occurred bugs that prevented progress when the previous demo version was released, we plan to proceed with a pre-release in consideration of various problems that may arise.  We encourage anyone who wants to try the game in advance to join, and if you have any mistranslation, bugs, other progress issues, or balance problems, we would appreciate it if you could let us know through the steam community.

Any important changes that occurred during the development process will be introduced gradually through news. The based system is same, but the rule in the game has changed in many areas compared to previous version, and there are also new additional systems, help you understand. Additionally, there is a newly added encyclopedia function in the game, so you can check it to get more detailed information. The encyclopedia function is still being added and improved to make it easier to convey content to you.

Finally, We would like to inform you about the price of the game. In the early days, TOD prices were measured at a high level. Because it was in the early stages of early access and the development was carried out with no investing and funding, there was a slight feeling of sponsorship. So, we released demo version in parallel, and thousands of people took interest in the game, which was unfinished and even unstable. Therefore, while expressing our gratitude, we are setting the final price low and even considering a launch discount. We hope that as many people as possible can enjoy our game without burden of price.

Thanks everyone who purchases and plays.

notes.title: Huge patch for 4th Towers has been released!
notes.notes:
Long time no see!
In the process of creating 4th towers scenario, we improved almost every aspect of the game's contents to make it more fun.
Thank you all for waiting for a long time. And, there is still the 5th towers left and that development is currently underway.

1. New Contents
- 4th Tower Scenario
Now, you can play all floors of 4th tower. Let's aim for clearing with the newly added content!

- Guide (need more upgrade)
An explanation has been added, but it's not complete. We'll continue to update the encyclopedia.

- 3Lv Class Upgrade
Class upgrade becomes possible by defeating Kensei(3rd mid-boss). You can enhance your passive skill and unlock two most powerful skills.

- Jeweler → Collector (replace with combination artifacts)
A Jeweler will be changed to a Collector. The accessory upgrade system will be deleted and combination artifact system will be added instead.
If you collect all specific artifacts, a combination item is unlocked. By paying a little gold, you can obtain powerful artifacts. The effects of sub-artifacts are still maintained.

- New Stats, Skills, Items, and etc

- New Monsters, Bosses, Tower Objects, and etc

2. Fix Contents
- Leveling Skill Cost(PP) according to tier
Current PP system has high cost requirements, making it hard to use many skills, especially in the early stages. Through leveling according to tier, we have made it possible to have more skills and adjusted the skills of higher tiers to show their true power.

- Player and Monster balance patch

- Modifications to functions, items, and costs in some stores

- Artifact balance patch

- Dot damage system balance patch
There were areas where the dot damage had an unintentionally strong effect. This worked for both players and mobs, so we made it rightly.

- Plaza NPC type and dialogue content modified

- Bug fix

notes.title: Regular update notice for 4th tower content
notes.notes:
Long time no see, everyone! A notice following the May developer note.
Before, let me explain why the developer notes suddenly stopped.

TOD has been in constant development up to this time, and we have been producing weekly and monthly news to deliver content and information to you more quickly.
However, due to efforts to quickly deliver information, content that was not fully established often changed after updates. Also, as development progressed, information to be included in news became scarce.
Beta uploads continued to be active, but we felt that writing news based on this was not a good idea, so we decided to stop releasing news during the June meeting and decide on regular builds at the top level.
We should have given you notice when we stopped writing the news, but we apologize for not thinking about it until this point.

[Updated content]
- Addition of all 4th tower stages
- Open all 4th tower contents except class upgrade
- Addition of new artifacts and combination artifacts
- Guidebook released
- Add animation/graphic things
- Reorganization of some local functions such as plaza and jeweler
- Big balance patch
